import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem exists_order_two_subgroup_with_nontrivial_quotient {G : Type*} [Fintype G] [CommGroup G] {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 10) (hG : Fintype.card G = 2 * n) : ∃ H : Subgroup G, H.Normal ∧ Nat.card H = 2 ∧ Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n ∧ Nontrivial (G ⧸ H) := by
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 2) := ⟨by decide⟩
  have h_dvd : 2 ∣ Fintype.card G := ⟨n, hG⟩
  have h_dvd_nat : 2 ∣ Nat.card G := ⟨n, by rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hG]⟩
  have h_elem : ∃ g : G, orderOf g = 2 := by exact?
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h_elem
  let H := Subgroup.zpowers g
  have hH_card : Nat.card H = 2 := by
    have h1 : Nat.card H = orderOf g := by exact?
    rw [h1, hg]
  have hH_normal : H.Normal := by exact?
  have h_lag : Nat.card G = Nat.card (G ⧸ H) * Nat.card H := by exact?
  have hG_nat : Nat.card G = 2 * n := by rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hG]
  have h_quot : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n := by
    rw [hH_card] at h_lag
    omega
  have h_nt : Nontrivial (G ⧸ H) := by
    have h1 : 1 < Nat.card (G ⧸ H) := by rw [h_quot]; omega
    exact?
  exact ⟨H, hH_normal, hH_card, h_quot, h_nt⟩
